simplecreatures.title: Simple Creatures
simplecreatures.option.mutedEntities.too:
List of entity IDs (e.g. minecraft:cow) whose
sounds are silenced. Default: [].
simplecreatures.option.nametagMuteSuffix:
List of name suffixes. Mobs named with one of
these will be silenced.
Default: ["_mute", "_shhh"].
simplecreatures.option.nametagBabySuffix:
Babies named with one of these suffixes will
never grow up (e.g., _baby). Default:
["_baby", "_small"].
simplecreatures.option.piglinsIgnoreGold:
Piglins won't attack if you wear armor with
gold trims. Default: true. Attacks and
container interactions can still anger
piglins.

Piglins won't attack if you hold gold tools
or weapons. Default: true. Attacks and
container interactions can still anger
piglins.
